result.summary: The page is largely intact; the only notable defect is a stray horizontal stroke overlapping the bottom navigation icons. Horizontal carousel clipping and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll behavior, not defects.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a thick horizontal line/stroke runs through the area between the search icon and the orders/bookmark icon, overlapping the icons instead of sitting as a clean tab indicator.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray stroke or reposition the tab indicator so it sits above or below the icons without crossing them, and verify the nav icons render cleanly.
